sharedBottleneck: A short observable trajectory X_1:20 does not determine long life T unless the source domain D preserves the relation between measured electrical behavior, hidden degradation state Z, and the source-specific end-of-life label. Randomly mixing cells lets train and test share D and therefore does not test that bridge.

holdsWhen: Training and target labels use compatible end-of-life definitions.
The target's dominant degradation and failure modes are represented in training.
The first 20 cycles expose variables sufficient for the intended prediction target.
Measurement processing preserves comparable physical quantities across sources.
A target-domain pilot is kept separate from the remaining adjudication cells.
breaksWhen: A latent localized defect or mechanical threshold leaves no early electrical signature.
Formation, rest, calendar aging, dynamic duty cycle, or temperature changes the conditional lifetime law rather than only the feature distribution.
Source-specific end-of-life thresholds make nominally identical cycle-life labels incomparable.
A target cell lies far outside every training-source feature neighborhood.
The same two target labels are used to choose, tune, and finally evaluate the correction.
surfaceAnalogyRisk: All three questions mention lifetime, but the connection is substantive only for the narrow subproblem represented by D → X_1:20 ← Z → T. A full manufacturing twin needs process and structure measurements, and an accelerated qualification needs verified mechanism preservation; neither follows from electrical prediction alone.
minimumVerificationTest: Freeze the 20-cycle extractor, admissibility rule, and prediction set before acquiring a fifth independently curated source. Hide its life labels; collect at least one orthogonal early measurement tied to an internal state—such as low-SOC resistance, ultrasound, pressure/expansion, or manufacturing telemetry—and compare electrical-only, multimodal, and abstaining arms on untouched cells.
transferableMethod: Use domain-held-out validation as the default unit, report support before accuracy, bound or refuse extrapolation, spend a small labelled pilot only after label-free coverage design, and reserve a separate target set for final adjudication.
validationStatus: The shared transport failure is reproduced by Python/NumPy and dependency-free Node implementations. It is validated only on four public processed source domains; field packs, multimodal internal states, new fabrication, safety failures, and independent laboratory replication all have denominator zero.

affectedProblems.UP-219: A model must expose an applicability domain and cannot infer every failure mode from early electrical curves.
affectedProblems.UP-233: A lifetime twin needs domain admissibility, source-specific uncertainty, and orthogonal state measurements before deployment.
affectedProblems.UP-234: A short test becomes evidence for long service only after mechanism and label semantics survive domain transfer.
